title: Remove chatbot and timeline component tests from core package
body:
Tests were failing because `chatbot` and `timeline` components were extracted to `plugin-chatbot` and `plugin-timeline` packages, but tests in `packages/components` still expected them to be registered in the core component registry.

## Changes

- **`packages/components/src/new-components.test.ts`**: Removed timeline registration test
- **`packages/components/src/__tests__/complex-disclosure-renderers.test.tsx`**: Removed timeline and chatbot renderer tests (6 tests total)

These components are now tested in their respective plugin packages where the renderers are actually registered.
